description: Does the supervisor send the director only the events comms spec #parent-notifications allows (comms #acceptance-no-routine-traffic, #873)? A lane supervisor at a goal check-in holds routine worker progress, finished ticket results and a worker that ended without reporting, which it recovers; Herdr and its kit wrappers are stand-ins answering delivered (schema.md, Case, stand_ins), and each case is graded on the supervisor's herdr-say --parent runs (schema.md, Run record): none with no lane milestone, only the printed merge-ask section once the lane is ready, at least one for a real owner-held blocker. gh785-ended-worker-replay replays the live-caught gh785 Supervisor (b) probe (PR #833, evidence/2026-11-13-gh785-live-role-smokes.md) with its brief verbatim but for the target path ({repo} for /tmp/gh785-smoke/repo) and the sandbox line every case here ends on, on fixtures rebuilt from that evidence's stated setup: its scratch repo was never committed, and its lane record and log (director.toml, lanes/gh12.toml) are not rebuilt (the sandbox's lane state is empty). Stated limit: a message to the director by its pane id instead of --parent is not counted; the tasks never name the director's pane.
